## Why This Is Asked

Tests scalability of KCA in mobile, roaming environments with hardware attestation, precise policy binding, and cross-region trust. Also evaluates revocation strategies and offline resilience.

## Key Concepts

- Hardware-backed roots and attestation
- Regional bootstrap services and cross-region trust anchors
- Central KCA issuing short-lived certificates (TTL ~15 minutes)
- SPIFFE ID policy binding per vehicle
- Certificate renewal on re-provision or roaming
- OCSP/CRLs revocation and offline root fallback
- Comprehensive auditing and end-to-end data flows

```python
def enroll(vehicle, region):

  csr = create_csr(vehicle, attestation, region)
  cert = central_ca.issue(csr, ttl=900)

```

```python
# CSR validation sketch
from cryptography import x509

def is_valid_csr(pem, allowed_spiffe):
    csr = x509.load_pem_x509_csr(pem.encode())
    san = csr.extensions.get_extension_for_class(x509.SubjectAlternativeName).value
    return any(spiffe in san.value for spiffe in allowed_spiffe)
```
